Their income ($266M 9M 2026 gains) is excluded from Adjusted EBITDA, so the asset belongs in the bridge (matching-asset rule). Private-mark risk: a 30% haircut would cost ~$3.3/share.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2027 base-case revenue growth, anchored to FY2026 guidance (~30%, decelerating) and the $15.8B bookings backlog of which 20-25% is expected to convert within 12 months; equity CAGR is rejected as a growth anchor because APIC is inflated by SBC credits and ATM issuance
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 36.7% vs EPS 3yr CAGR -8.2%: equity growth is driven by SBC credited to APIC (~$1.3B over FY2023-25) and $462M of ATM equity raised, not by retained earnings; EPS is depressed by SBC, acquisition amortisation and interest on $1.75B of senior notes. Neither is a clean growth anchor; revenue (32.8%/32.5%) is.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - net-settlement equity taxes - interest income) has been NEGATIVE in every year FY2021-FY2026E: FY2021 -$561.5M, FY2022 -$74.0M, FY2023 -$273.4M, FY2024 -$155.0M, FY2025 -$985.5M, FY2026E ~-$439M (millions USD; interest income FY2021-22 from the FY2023 10-K 'interest income, net'). A CAGR on a negative series is undefined, so fcf CAGRs are null. Reported FCF went $179.6M (FY2022) -> $75.1M (FY2025), a -25% 3yr CAGR, while revenue compounded at 33%: all of the reported growth, and more, has been paid for in stock and working capital. SBC rose from 20.5% of revenue (FY2022) to 22.8% (FY2025) before the FY2026 guide of 16.2%.

scenario_narratives.base: Axon converts the $15.8B bookings backlog and 126% net revenue retention into ~24% growth in FY2027, including the ~$130M of Federal Dedrone deployments pushed out of FY2026, then decelerates toward a mature public-safety-software growth rate as the US body-camera and TASER installed base saturates and growth shifts to international (~18% of revenue), NG911 and counter-drone. Software & Services (45% of revenue, +38-43% YoY) lifts the Adjusted EBITDA margin from 25.6% to 32% over ten years despite adjusted gross margin having compressed to 61.2% on counter-drone mix and memory costs. SBC falls from 16% to 8% of revenue as the fixed XSP pool amortises against a tripling revenue base. The structural working-capital drag from bundled hardware (contract assets $1.17B and growing) shrinks only as growth slows. Owner FCF is negative in FY2027 and turns meaningfully positive from FY2029; the terminal year carries most of the value.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI Era Plan (Draft One, Real-Time Translation, Axon Assistant) and the NG911 stack (Carbyne, Prepared) raise per-officer ARPU faster than the installed base matures, EMEA and other international markets adopt TASER 10 and Axon Evidence at scale, and Dedrone/Skydio make Axon the default drone-as-first-responder platform. Growth holds near 28% for two years and is still 12% in year 7; software passes 60% of revenue and the Adjusted EBITDA margin reaches 36%; SBC falls to 7%; WC drag eases as billing shifts to annual-in-advance software. Strategic investments (Skydio ~37%) are worth more than carrying value.
scenario_narratives.bear: Municipal and federal appropriations pressure, a government shutdown or two, and sustained EFF/ACLU-driven backlash plus state AI-disclosure laws (Utah SB 180, California SB 524) slow Draft One adoption and lengthen sales cycles; Motorola Solutions and Flock Safety compete harder on price in cameras and real-time operations. Growth is 18% in FY2027 and single digits by FY2031. Hardware mix (counter-drone, TASER 10 capacity, memory costs) and acquisition integration keep the Adjusted EBITDA margin near 27%, SBC stays sticky above 10% because XSP tranches 4-9 continue to expense regardless of price goals, and realised award value plus net-settlement taxes keep exceeding grant-date expense. The $1.75B of 6.1-6.3% senior notes and the $1.15B converts are serviced from a business whose owner FCF stays negative until FY2030. Inherited litigation (CentralSquare v Carbyne, Airspace v Dedrone, ALPR class actions) adds cost.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Axon is a genuine franchise - a near-monopoly in US less-lethal weapons and body cameras with an ecosystem that is converting into recurring software at 40% ARR growth - but on an owner-FCF basis it has not yet generated cash for shareholders: every dollar of reported FCF and more has gone to SBC, net-settlement taxes and working capital. The valuation therefore rests on the terminal year, so the model is long-horizon (10 years), charges SBC in full on a declining % path, models the contract-asset working-capital drag on revenue growth, and caps the exit multiple. The house (SBC-expensed) and street (SBC-as-non-cash) values bracket the market price; where the price sits in that band is the main finding.
key_risks_to_valuation: SBC glide 16% -> 8% is the single largest assumption: each 1pp of terminal SBC is worth roughly $8-9/share; XSP tranches 4-9 continue to expense whether or not price goals are met

Working-capital capture at -40% of the revenue increase: contract assets from 5-year bundled plans have absorbed 40-60% of incremental revenue since FY2023; if Axon shifts billing terms the drag could ease (bull) or worsen with hardware mix (bear)
Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion to 32% against an adjusted gross margin that has fallen to 61.2% on counter-drone and memory costs
Terminal value is the majority of EV at a 9.5% WACC / 3% terminal growth; a 1pp move in WACC moves value by ~20%
Strategic investments ($925M, mainly Skydio) carried at private-round marks in the bridge; a further ~$1.2B is being committed post balance-sheet date
Government budget/appropriations risk and AI-in-policing regulation (Draft One) on a customer base that is ~82% US public sector
Dilution overhang if the stock recovers: 2027 Warrants ($338.86) and 2031 converts ($652.06) are excluded at today's price

inputs.buyback_note: No open-market repurchases in FY2025 or 9M 2026; the company is a net ISSUER (ATM equity programme: $362.2M FY2025, $100.3M 9M 2026). The flat count is therefore a modelling convention the company has not paid for in cash - the net-settlement tax payments (~$200-350M/yr) are the only in-substance repurchase.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T21:00:01Z regular close (first full session after the 2026-11-05 Q3 print and guidance cut)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. Rf ~4.2% (10y UST), ERP 5.0%, beta ~1.25 -> cost of equity ~10.5%; pre-tax cost of debt 6.2% (2030/2033 Senior Notes) and 0% coupon converts, ~4.8% after tax; debt ~10% of EV at $313 -> WACC ~9.9%, rounded to 9.5% for a low-cyclicality, government-customer, contracted-backlog business. One WACC across scenarios; risk is charged in the driver paths and weights, not twice.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) operating leases stay inside EBITDA as rent expense (ASC 842 operating leases, total lease liabilities ~$125M); lease liabilities are NOT in net debt. Immaterial either way.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (margins still ramping at year 5), scenario-weighted. Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 1 (operating company: SaaS/hardware ecosystem). First valuation of this ticker. KEY JUDGMENTS: (1) Owner FCF is NEGATIVE today and in year 1: FY2026E reported FCF ~$375M is less than SBC ~$585M, and the company also pays ~$200-350M/yr of cash tax on net-settled awards and raises equity via an ATM. The valuation therefore depends almost entirely on the margin/SBC glide and the terminal year. (2) WORKING CAPITAL is a large structural drag: hardware in the bundled AI Era / Officer Safety Plans is recognised on delivery but billed over 5 years, so contract assets (+$405M in 9M 2026, $1.17B total) grow with bookings; receivables and inventory added a further drag. Measured drag FY2023-FY2026E is ~40-60% of the YoY revenue increase; base uses -40% capture (bull -30%, bear -50%). The engine applies it to the revenue CHANGE so it shrinks as growth decelerates. (3) SBC path anchors to the FY2026 guide (16.2% of revenue) and glides to 8% by year 10 (mature software/hardware peer range 8-12%; MSI ~2.5%); the XSP pool is a fixed ~5.2M shares whose expense is front-loaded. The ~$200M/yr net-settlement tax is treated as the in-substance buyback that funds the flat count (not charged twice); when realised award value exceeds grant-date expense, as in 2025, the charge understates true cost - a bear-side risk noted in the narrative. (4) Adjusted EBITDA margin from the 25.6% FY2026 guide toward 32% (base) / 36% (bull) / 27% (bear) by year 10, net of the adjusted-gross-margin compression to 61.2% from counter-drone mix. (5) Cash tax ramps from 18% (9M 2026 GAAP ETR, SBC deductions and R&D credits) to 23%. (6) TIMING: FY0 = FY2026E and year 1 = FY2027, discounted one full period from a November 2026 valuation date; Q4 2026 cash flow (expected to be strongly positive on a reported basis) is not separately captured, which is conservative. (7) SKYDIO (subsequent event 2026-11-05): up to $1.2B additional investment, ~$720M cash + ~$480M in AXON shares, taking ownership from 15% to ~37%; primary $254.9M tranche closed 2026-11-05. Not pre-booked: it is an asset swap at a fresh observable round, so cash down / strategic investments up / ~1.5M shares issued against ~$480M of asset is per-share neutral at carrying value. Refresh cash, strategic investments and the share count at the FY2026 10-K. (8) Interest income FY2026E ~$29M < 1x any positive FCF base, but is stripped anyway because the $1.66B of cash is added back in full.

bear.narrative: Growth steps down to 18% in FY2027 as federal/municipal budgets tighten, AI-in-policing backlash slows Draft One, and the US body-camera base saturates; revenue ~$7.8B by FY2036 (8% CAGR). Margin stalls near 27% on hardware mix, AI compute and acquisition integration costs; SBC stays sticky at 16% -> 10%; WC drag 50% as bundled hardware keeps outrunning billings.

base.narrative: Growth 24% in FY2027 (backlog conversion plus the slipped Federal Dedrone deployments), decelerating ~3-4pp a year to 5% by FY2036 (revenue ~$11.4B, 12% CAGR). Adjusted EBITDA margin expands from the 25.6% FY2026 guide to 32% as Software & Services passes 50% of revenue, partly offset by hardware mix. SBC glides 16% -> 8% of revenue. WC drag 40% of the revenue increase. Cash tax 18% -> 23%.

bull.narrative: Growth holds in the high 20s for two more years as international (EMEA), NG911 (Carbyne/Prepared), counter-drone and Draft One/AI Era Plan attach all land; revenue ~$15.8B by FY2036 (16% CAGR). Margin to 36% as software mix dominates; SBC to 7%; WC drag eases to 30% as billing shifts toward annual-in-advance software.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 20%: the FY2026 revenue guide was just cut (32-34% -> ~30%) and FCF guide cut ($450M -> $350-400M), adjusted gross margin is compressing, owner FCF is negative, leverage has tripled to fund M&A, and the customer base is politically exposed government budgets. Bull trimmed from 35% to 30%: the bull case needs international, NG911, counter-drone AND a 10pp margin expansion to land together against a hardware-mix headwind. Base 50%: Axon's execution record (a decade of 25-35% growth, backlog +39% YoY, NRR 126%) is strong enough that the central path deserves the usual weight. Not a going-concern or single-regulator situation, so bear is not pushed to 25-35%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
